paper_title: Earth as a transducer for dark-photon dark-matter detection
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter epsilon (chi), dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper (Fedderke, Graham, Kimball, Kalia 2106.00022) proposes Earth as transducer for dark-photon DM and summarizes the SuperMAG geomagnetic search from companion paper arXiv:2108.08852. New 95%-credible upper limits on kinetic mixing epsilon in the mass range 2e-18 eV < m_A' < 7e-17 eV (6e-4 to 2e-2 Hz), assuming the dark photon is all of the local dark matter. The actual numerical limit curve appears only in Fig. 4 (jagged, frequency-by-frequency limits); no numerical table or in-text values are given, so the data_points above are APPROXIMATE reconstructions of the smoothed limit envelope from general knowledge of the published SuperMAG result and should be replaced with digitized Fig. 4 / companion-paper data.
